quiz.explanation: hiervon: of this, from this, about this.

goodToKnow: Hiervon means of this, from this or about this, and is typical of formal writing such as contracts, terms and conditions and notices: Hiervon ausgenommen sind... (excepted from this are...). In speech, Germans use davon instead. German has a whole family of hier- compounds: hierzu (in addition to this), hierfür (for this), hierbei (in this case), hiermit (herewith): Hiermit kündige ich meinen Vertrag, the classic opening of a cancellation letter.
